name: mcode_exec
description: Run an arbitrary bash command in the workspace from the repo root — the primitive that makes the remote code feel local. Returns { output, exit_code }. Bounded to 120s; for long builds/tests use mcode_build / mcode_test. Requires write scope + a ready workspace.

cmd.description: Bash command to run, e.g. 'ls -la' or 'grep -rn TODO src'.
